title: Blanquet to Rubio Navarrete, 19 May 1914: a War Ministry telegram in "Clave núm. 109" (CEHM DLXXIII), decoded, not read

plaintext.source: Handwritten telegram, clear Spanish with Clave núm. 109 groups; no contemporary decipherment.

system.summary: Printed numerical table of 160 numbers (Clave núm. 109: letters with homophones for the vowels, syllables, military words), numbers set in the clear text

prior_solution.where: Not in the repository before 22 Nov 2026, the Tomokiyo index, or R. Narváez's 2015 and 2025 articles. Narváez, Criptografía diplomática, política y militar en México 1813-1926 (SRE, 2019), checked 21-22 Nov 2026 from photographs of a loan copy (chapters VII-XI, pp. 261-410, and the index, pp. 487-495): it prints neither the telegram(s) nor the key.

conditions.human_role: Andrew Beling chose the target, set the rules (frozen plans, blind transcriptions, controls) and photographed the Narváez book; AI agents transcribed, rebuilt and tested the key and wrote up.
models: AI agents run by Andrew Beling; the model of each step is not recorded in the work files (Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic, for the 22 Nov 2026 steps)

solution.what: 19 May 1914 and 25 Mar 1914 telegrams transcribed by two blind AI readers: 90/98 and 100/107 positions agreed.
Clave núm. 109 (rubio1913/key.tsv, Brice Dudout) applied unchanged to the held-out 19 May telegram: 90/98 groups, beat 1,000/1,000 shuffles.
Same key on the 25 Mar 1914 telegram to Huerta (DLXXIII.2.41.17-41): beat 418/1,000 shuffles (miss).
Narváez 2019, chapters VII-XI and index, checked from photographs: neither the telegram nor Clave 109 printed.

Frozen test of the limantour1909 key, the Villa key of open PR 865 and Jalkut's two-digit card (duron1911): the first two cover too few groups; the card beat 2 and 888 of 1,000 shuffles (miss); Clave 109 control passed.
Strict count (every letter from the key): 15 of 25 cipher words.

outcome.method_basis: The printed key sheet issued to Rubio (DLXXIII.1.28.14-23), transcribed by Brice Dudout in rubio1913, applied unchanged.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 15 of 25 cipher words with every letter from the key (may19_words.tsv).

gaps.detail: eight groups cut, faint or under the watermark on the viewer images
Clave 109 missed; the presidential code is not in the fonds

credits.note: with AI agents: telegram transcribed blind twice and decoded with Clave 109
Clave núm. 109 key sheet identified and transcribed (rubio1913/key.tsv)

texts.label: 19 May 1914, Blanquet to Rubio (DLXXIII.2.41.22-41)
texts.summary: Rubio is told to refrain from representations about certain individuals and to proceed with energy.
